name: Hypixel utils
description: Hypixel helpers: game detection from the sidebar, staff alerts, auto GG and auto play, game profiles, coordinates, private message alerts and chat logging.

addons.GameDetector: Detects the current Hypixel game from the sidebar and shares it with the other addons. Shows the game in a HUD panel.
addons.StaffAlert: Alerts when a staff rank tag shows in the tab list: chat, sound and a HUD flash. Can send /lobby.
addons.AutoGG: Sends a message (default gg) once after each game ends, after a short random delay.
addons.AutoPlay: After a game ends, waits and sends /play with the mode you chose.
addons.ShareCoords: Sends your coordinates to chat when you press its button. Prefix decides the channel.
addons.PrivateMessageAlert: Sound and HUD flash when someone sends you a private message.
addons.ChatLogger: Writes chat to a daily log in the Arsenic folder. Off until you enable it.
addons.GameProfiles: Turns modules on or off when the Hypixel game changes, from per-game lists.
addons.BetterChat: Chat timestamps, and a marker on lines that mention your name. Keeps the server's colours.
